config.queue.missing_dlx.title: Queue without dead-letter exchange
config.queue.missing_dlx.description: {{queueName}} in vhost {{vhost}} has no dead-letter exchange configured. Messages that are rejected or expire will be silently dropped.
config.queue.missing_dlx.fix: Declare a dead-letter exchange and set x-dead-letter-exchange on the queue or via a policy.
config.user.guest_enabled.title: Default guest user is enabled
config.user.guest_enabled.description: The default guest user exists on this cluster. It uses a well-known password and is a common attack vector.
config.user.guest_enabled.fix: Delete the guest user or restrict it to loopback-only access.
config.vhost.default_unscoped.title: Production resources in default vhost
config.vhost.default_unscoped.descriptio: Active queues found in the default '/' vhost. Using the default vhost mixes environments and complicates access control.
config.vhost.default_unscoped.fix: Create dedicated vhosts per environment or tenant and migrate resources to them.
config.queue.classic_mirrored_deprecated: {{queueName}} in vhost {{vhost}} uses classic queue mirroring via an HA policy, which is deprecated in RabbitMQ 4.x and removed in 4.0.
Migrate to Quorum Queues and remove the HA policy.
config.queue.exclusive_in_production.des: {{queueName}} in vhost {{vhost}} is an exclusive queue with active messages or consumers. Exclusive queues are deleted when their connection closes.
config.queue.exclusive_in_production.fix: Use a regular durable queue if persistence across reconnects is required.
config.policy.conflicting.title: Conflicting policies at equal priority
config.policy.conflicting.description: Policies {{policyA}} and {{policyB}} in vhost {{vhost}} have overlapping definition keys at the same priority. RabbitMQ resolves this non-deterministically.
config.policy.conflicting.fix: Increase the priority of the intended policy or merge the conflicting definitions into one.
config.node.watermark_misconfig.title: Memory or disk watermark misconfigured
config.node.watermark_misconfig.descript: Node {{nodeName}} has a low memory limit or disk free threshold. This may cause the broker to block publishers prematurely.
config.node.watermark_misconfig.fix: Set vm_memory_high_watermark to 0.4–0.6 and disk_free_limit to at least 1 GB.
config.consumer.prefetch_misconfig.title: Consumer prefetch count is unbounded or excessive
config.consumer.prefetch_misconfig.descr: A consumer on {{queueName}} in vhost {{vhost}} has prefetch_count={{prefetchCount}}. Unbounded prefetch can starve other consumers; excessive prefetch wastes memory.
config.consumer.prefetch_misconfig.fix: Set a bounded prefetch count (typically 10–100) per consumer.
config.exchange.orphan.title: Exchange with no outgoing bindings
config.exchange.orphan.description: Exchange {{exchangeName}} in vhost {{vhost}} has no bindings. Messages published to it will be silently dropped.
config.exchange.orphan.fix: Remove the exchange if it is unused, or add bindings to route its messages.
config.queue.no_consumer_backlog.title: Queue has messages but no consumers
config.queue.no_consumer_backlog.descrip: {{queueName}} in vhost {{vhost}} has {{messages}} messages and no active consumers. Messages are accumulating with no one to process them.
config.queue.no_consumer_backlog.fix: Start consumers for this queue or verify connectivity.
